vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do every day, usually in the same order
vocabulary.example: My daily routine starts at six o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: normal; usual
vocabulary.example: On a typical day, I study for three hours.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stop sleeping
vocabulary.example: I wake up early every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clean your teeth with a toothbrush
vocabulary.example: I brush my teeth twice a day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clean your face with water
vocabulary.example: I wash my face with cold water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first meal of the day
vocabulary.example: I eat eggs for breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food made from grain, eaten with milk
vocabulary.example: The children like cereal with milk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: put on your clothes
vocabulary.example: I get dressed after breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you study after school
vocabulary.example: My brother goes to college in the city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: go to a class or event
vocabulary.example: I attend three classes every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short time to rest between classes
vocabulary.example: We eat a snack at break time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small amount of food between meals
vocabulary.example: An apple is a healthy snack.

vocabulary.meaning_en: rest and feel calm
vocabulary.example: I relax after a long day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: small jobs you do at home, like cleaning
vocabulary.example: I help my mother with the chores.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clean plates, cups and pans after eating
vocabulary.example: I wash the dishes after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the main meal in the evening
vocabulary.example: We have dinner at seven.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wash your body under running water
vocabulary.example: I take a shower every evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: do the things you do before sleeping
vocabulary.example: I get ready for bed at ten.

vocabulary.meaning_en: start to sleep
vocabulary.example: I fall asleep quickly when I'm tired.

vocabulary.meaning_en: lie down in bed to sleep
vocabulary.example: I go to bed at eleven o'clock.

fine_lines.title: wake up vs get up
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wake up تعني تستيقظ (تفتح عينيك)، و get up تعني تنهض من السرير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Wake up = stop sleeping. Get up = leave your bed.

examples.sentence: I get up at quarter past six.

fine_lines.title: go to bed vs fall asleep
fine_lines.explanation_ar: go to bed تعني تذهب إلى السرير، و fall asleep تعني تبدأ بالنوم فعلًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Go to bed = lie down in bed. Fall asleep = start sleeping.

examples.sentence: I go to bed at ten.
I fall asleep at half past ten.

expressions.phrase: Let me tell you about my typical day.
expressions.example: Let me tell you about my typical day. I wake up at six.

expressions.phrase: In the morning, I wake up early.
expressions.meaning_en: Say what you do in the morning.
expressions.example: In the morning, I wake up early and pray.

expressions.phrase: I go to college by bus.
expressions.example: I go to work by bus.

expressions.phrase: When my classes are over, I come back home.
expressions.meaning_ar: عندما تنتهي حصصي أعود إلى البيت.
expressions.meaning_en: Say what you do after classes.
expressions.example: When my classes are over, I come back home and rest.

expressions.phrase: I help my mom with chores.
expressions.meaning_en: Say how you help at home.
expressions.example: On Saturday I help my mom with chores.
What is your daily routine? I study in the morning.

grammar.title: Present simple for routines
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للأشياء التي نفعلها كل يوم: I wake up early. I go to college by bus. ومع he/she نضيف s: She wakes up early.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present simple for things you do every day. With he/she add -s.
examples: I brush my teeth and wash my face.
She goes to college by bus.

grammar.title: Sequence words: then, after, before, when
grammar.explanation_ar: نرتّب الأحداث بكلمات مثل: Then (ثم)، After breakfast (بعد الفطور)، Before I sleep (قبل أن أنام)، When my classes are over (عندما تنتهي حصصي).
grammar.explanation_en: Use then, after, before and when to put actions in order.
examples: Then, I make breakfast for myself.
Before I sleep, I read a book.

grammar.title: Frequency words: usually, sometimes
grammar.explanation_ar: usually تعني عادةً، و sometimes تعني أحيانًا. تأتي قبل الفعل غالبًا، ويمكن وضع sometimes في أول الجملة.
grammar.explanation_en: Usually and sometimes show how often. They usually go before the verb; sometimes can start the sentence.
examples: I usually have cereal with milk and tea.

questions.question: In the morning, I ___ up early.
questions.explanation_ar: مع I نستخدم wake بدون s.

questions.question: What are "chores"?
questions.explanation_en: Chores are small jobs at home.

questions.question: ___ breakfast, I get dressed.
questions.explanation_ar: أولًا الفطور ثم اللبس: After breakfast.
questions.explanation_en: First breakfast, then clothes: After breakfast.

questions.question: Which is the first meal of the day?
I ___ have cereal with milk and tea. (= most days)
After dinner, I take a ___ and get ready for bed.
